newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - AMR Corp EPS estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - AMR Corp EPS estimates cut.

text.p: - Gruntal & Co analyst Steve Lewins said Monday he cut his third quarter earnings estimates for AMR Corp, the parent of American Airlines, to $3.00 a share from $3.50 a share.
- Lewins also cut AMR's 1996 earnings estimate to $9.25 a share from $10.00 a share and cut the 1997 estimate to $10.00 a share from $10.50 a share.
- Lewins said "AMR may end up with essentially flat third quarter earnings."
- Lewins cited increased jet kerosene costs and legal costs related to the settlement of litigation with travel agents.

- American's new pilot contract includes higher wages and no compensations for the airline, he said. "This is a disappointment because we think American Airlines' unit costs are too high relative to other long-haul carriers," Lewins said.

- American recently joined other U.S. carriers in raising fares. "The price increase appear to be sticking, but there may be an impact on bookings that other carriers have not experienced or reported," Lewins said.
